searchText: > Do I need to have a huge machine to do so? Yes, I have one with 200GB of RAM I used for simulating gossipsubv2. Would you like to access the machine or would like me to simulate your poc first to see how much memory the sim (with empty blocks and no blobs) takes? I think your branch is here https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/14813 I'm not sure how to build the binaries from source. The prysm doc only tells me how to run it using bazel, https://www.offchainlabs.com/prysm/docs/install/install-with-bazel/#run-a-beacon-node but I need a real binary like the one here https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/releases/download/v5.3.2/beacon-chain-v5.3.2-linux-amd64 Ah perfect, yeah I'm preparing binaries right now for a devnet at the same time so that I bench against develop, will ping you in a bit So it's not easy for someone to build the binaries themselves? with bazel is very simple ah <@964433541813375036> you'll need my binaries anyway, I'm building special ones that delay the block broadcast so that I can actually meassure how long transfer takes that's not in that branch These are the images: gcr.io/prylabs-dev/prysm/validator:HEAD-11fd5cb gcr.io/prylabs-dev/prysm/beacon-chain:HEAD-11fd5cb you will need --delay-block-broadcast=2s - --use-rlnc In the beacon (the former is so that you know that block production is not being counted as part of broadcasting) And in the vc - --use-rlnc The vanilla non RNLC version is without the use-rlnc flags

excerpts.author: popef
excerpts.content:
> Do I need to have a huge machine to do so? 
Yes, I have one with 200GB of RAM I used for simulating gossipsubv2. Would you like to access the machine or would like me to simulate your poc first to see how much memory the sim (with empty blocks and no blobs) takes?

excerpts.author: popef
excerpts.content:
I think your branch is here https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/14813
I'm not sure how to build the binaries from source.  The prysm doc only tells me how to run it using bazel, https://www.offchainlabs.com/prysm/docs/install/install-with-bazel/#run-a-beacon-node but I need a real binary like the one here https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/releases/download/v5.3.2/beacon-chain-v5.3.2-linux-amd64

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Ah perfect, yeah I'm preparing binaries right now for a devnet at the same time so that I bench against develop, will ping you in a bit

excerpts.author: popef
excerpts.content: So it's not easy for someone to build the binaries  themselves?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: ah <@964433541813375036> you'll need my binaries anyway, I'm building special ones that delay the block broadcast so that I can actually meassure how long transfer takes

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
These are the images:

gcr.io/prylabs-dev/prysm/validator:HEAD-11fd5cb
gcr.io/prylabs-dev/prysm/beacon-chain:HEAD-11fd5cb

 you will need --delay-block-broadcast=2s
      - --use-rlnc
   
In the beacon (the former is so that you know that block production is not being counted as part of broadcasting) 

And in the vc
      - --use-rlnc

The vanilla non RNLC version is without the use-rlnc flags
